readOnly: Read only: this content cannot be edited right now.
footerNote: Saving stores a draft. Publishing depends on editorial review.

sections.coverDescription: Take a photo now or choose a photo or video already on your phone. From a video, a frame becomes the cover.
sections.mediaDescription: In this demo, videos are embedded from YouTube or Vimeo. Without media, the simulated player uses the transcript.
sections.bodyDescription: Educational content. Avoid individual prescriptions and promises of results.
sections.accessDescription: The app is free: all published content is open to signed-in users. Here you only choose how completion is recorded.
sections.licenseDescription: Where the media comes from and who must be credited. Videos embedded from YouTube or Vimeo require the "third-party embed" license.
sections.blocksDescription: The pillar sets the block: a workout with checkable steps, nutrition with a recipe, product or dish, or the chef's menu. The program is a separate block.
sections.blocksLoading: Loading the hero's recipes, products and programs…
sections.blocksRoutine: Routine opens no block: the content goes out with text, photo or video only. Change the pillar to open workout, nutrition or menu.
sections.productsDescription: Store products shown under "Related products" on the content page. The link is validated right away.

fields.title: Title
fields.summaryHint: One or two sentences for the card and search.
fields.typeHint: Changing the type switches the editor; data from another type is discarded.
fields.sourceLocaleHint: Language the content was written in.
fields.disclaimerHint: Shown to the public alongside the content.
fields.tagsHint: Up to 12 keywords. Enter or comma adds.
fields.hasCaptionsHint: Check when the video offers captions.

cover.title: Content cover
cover.none: No cover. Take a photo or pick a photo or video from your phone.
cover.previewDescription: This is how the cover will look on cards and at the top of the content. Confirm to upload.
cover.preparingVideo: Grabbing a frame from the video…
cover.uploaded: Cover uploaded. It is stored when you save the content.
cover.removed: Cover removed. Save the content to confirm.
cover.limits: Photo up to 30 MB or video up to 300 MB (from a video, a frame near the start becomes the cover). The image is resized on your device, without location data. Up to 30 uploads per hour.
cover.unavailable: Cover upload is not available in this environment.
cover.disabled: Photo uploads are paused by the administration. Try again later.

errors.creator_required: Choose the responsible hero before uploading the cover.
errors.not_media: That file is neither a photo nor a video. Choose another one.
errors.not_image: That file is not a photo. Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP photo, or a video.
errors.empty_file: The file is empty. Choose another one.
errors.file_too_large: The file is too large. Photo up to 30 MB or video up to 300 MB.
errors.decode_failed: This browser could not open that file (HEIC and some videos sometimes fail). Try a JPG or PNG photo, or an MP4 video.
errors.invalid_dimensions: The cover did not arrive in the expected format. Try again.
errors.too_many_uploads: Limit of 30 uploads per hour reached. Try again later.
errors.uploads_disabled: Photo uploads are paused by the administration. Try again later.
errors.photo_not_configured: Cover upload is not available in this environment.
errors.not_a_hero: The chosen hero is not active. Choose another hero and try again.
errors.forbidden: Only the administrator uploads covers here.
errors.upload_failed: The cover could not be uploaded. Check your connection and try again.
errors.upload_rights_required: Before the first upload, confirm that you hold the rights to the photo or video.

media.providerHint: Stream and Mux stay disabled until configured.
media.streamUploaded: Video uploaded from the phone (Cloudflare Stream). To replace the video, make a new post.
media.refHintYoutube: Accepts the 11-character ID or youtube.com/watch, youtu.be, shorts and embed URLs.
media.refHintVimeo: Accepts the numeric ID or vimeo.com/<id> and player.vimeo.com/video/<id> URLs.
media.previewInvalid: We could not recognise that ID/URL.
media.previewEmpty: Paste the ID or URL to validate.
media.captionsHint: Platform path or https URL of a .vtt file.

healthClaims.label: Health claims notice
healthClaims.title: Careful with health claims
healthClaims.description: We found terms that may sound like a promise of cure, guaranteed weight loss, diagnosis or treatment. Platform content is educational and does not replace individual professional guidance. You can still save, but editorial review may ask for changes.

video.introHint: What the video is about and who it is for.
video.transcriptHint: Second at which each segment starts and the spoken text. Used by the simulated player and for accessibility.

recipe.ingredientsHint: Item and quantity (e.g. Olive oil · 1 tablespoon).
recipe.stepsHint: One step per item, in order.

nutrition.title: Nutrition facts (per serving)
nutrition.hint: Estimated values. Shown to the public only after validation by the admin team.
nutrition.validatedHint: Releases the numbers to the public. Requires a responsible person and a date.
nutrition.validatedByHint: Name and credential, e.g. Registered Dietitian 00000.
nutrition.resetOnSave: Saving clears the validation; the admin team must validate again.
nutrition.adminOnly: Validation is done by the admin team; until then the public only sees "under validation".

workout.safetyNoteHint: E.g. stop if you feel pain and seek a qualified professional.
